verdict.rationale: Sumsub has building blocks for background automation: webhooks push verification events automatically, client lists feed transaction-monitoring rules, anomaly detection monitors transactions, and an MCP server lets AI agents perform Sumsub operations. However, there is no evidence of a native, user-configurable automation or workflow builder that runs autonomous jobs. Most autonomy would have to be assembled externally on top of webhooks, the API or agents. Missing for 10: a first-party automation/workflow builder, scheduled or triggered background jobs configurable in-product, documentation of autonomous agent runs, independent corroboration.
